title: Python API (developer mode) - kiss_slam_pipeline throws errors
body:
Thank you for publishing your work!

After your latest commit, I am able to install the package as an editable. However, 
`$ kiss_slam_pipeline -v <dataset>`
is giving the following error:

> Running cmake --build & --install in /home/kiss-slam/build/cp312-cp312-linux_x86_64
> [0/1] Re-running CMake...
> /bin/sh: 1: /tmp/pip-build-env-aoqahp9b/normal/lib/python3.12/site-packages/cmake/data/bin/cmake: not found
> FAILED: build.ninja 
> /tmp/pip-build-env-aoqahp9b/normal/lib/python3.12/site-packages/cmake/data/bin/cmake --regenerate-during-build -S/home/kiss-slam -B/home/kiss-slam/build/cp312-cp312-linux_x86_64
> ninja: error: rebuilding 'build.ninja': subcommand failed
> ERROR: None

Please let me know if I am doing something wrong.
author: shin-ka

comments.body:
Please try installing with

```
pip install --no-build-isolation -ve .
```

title: Kiss-VINS series?
body: Thanks for the work on the kiss series, they are really easy to use! Are there any plans to do some work on the kiss-vins series?
author: lif314

comments.body: Hi @lif314, at the moment we don't plan to work in VINS, although there will be a VO work KISS style coming out soon. Although I will be happy if someone decide to start working on VINS with the KISS principle 😜
@tizianoGuadagnino Thanks, I will close this issue.

title: Addition of intensity field
body:
Thank you for providing such great source code.

Do you have any plans to add support for saving the intensity field in a PLY file?
It would be great if this feature could be added! :)

Thank you!
author: dbparkJ

comments.body: So far, we have not planned this. This would increase the complexity of the dataloaders. We currently do not read intensity information because our pipeline does not require it. But feel free to open a PR on this, we can discuss it there!
